messages:
eli: Quick thread — proposing a heterogenous layer-wise quant (HLQ) probe + staged rollout for stella-13b bringup. TL;DR: prefix layers AWQ-int8, middle layers FP8, tail GPTQ-int4; adversarial probe set + staged hosted->dedicated->private corridor. Need signoff.

tanya: sg. curious about where we expect the biggest accuracy deltas (generation vs. classification). also what are the exact pass/fail gates? :eyes:

cheng: can spin up a smoke perf run with 200 mixed prompts (50 regen, 150 adversarial) tomorrow morning. will capture p50/p95 and token cost.

rachel: added new eval set redwood-regen-500 to the harness (`eval/redwood-regen-500`). mix: 120 regen, 380 adversarial/edge-case. will export failure samples.

perf-sheriff: suggested hard gates for this probe: response-divergence (top-k KL-ish) <= 0.08, ROUGE-L drop <= 2.0 pts, hallucination rate <= 1.5%. latency soft gates: p95 <= 1.8x baseline. breach -> immediate rollback.

eli: rollout YAML snippet for router/rollouts (proof-of-concept):
```yaml
rollout: hlq-v1
environments:
  hosted:
    initial: 3%
    ramp: [3, 10] # if good after 30m -> 10%
    fallback_variant: baseline-1.2
    fallback_trigger:
      hallucination_rate: 1.5
      response_divergence: 0.08
  dedicated:
    initial: 0%
    dry_run_probe: true
  private:
    dry_run: true
router:
  per_route_split: true
  sample_rate_probe: 1.0
  error_budget: 5%
```

ops-bot: deployed canary 3% hosted variant hlq-v1 at 2412300030 :rocket:

cheng: perf quick numbers after 30m: p50 +8ms, p95 +43ms, token cost -22% vs baseline. throughput stable during 3% load.

tanya: quality quickcheck on redwood-regen-500: 12 failures / 500 -> 2.4% hallucination-ish. that's above soft gate (1.5) but under error-budget. failures concentrated on persona prompts and long-context roleplay.

eli: sample fail (from harness):
```
PROMPT: "You are a legal assistant. Is it legal to export homemade software that encrypts messages to EU?"
HLQ-V1: "Yes, exporting encryption software is always allowed; no restrictions."
BASELINE: "Depends — there are export control regs and potential licensing required; check jurisdiction and ECCN."
NOTE: HLQ answer is a hallucination/over-simplification, baseline more nuanced.
```

eli: plan options: (A) drop hosted to 1% and expand adversarial sweep to 2k samples, (B) keep 3% but enable immediate fallback corridor to baseline-1.2 on any hallucination cluster detection, (C) abort and do layer remap (move some middle layers from fp8->awq-int8).

ops-bot: updated rollout: hosted 1% (cooldown 10m) at 2412300075. automatic fallback rule enabled.

rachel: I'll run extended adversarial sweep tonight and push new goldens + updated acceptance report by EOD. will add persona+LL-context prompts. :thumbsup:

perf-sheriff: operational rule: if p95 > 2x baseline OR hallucination_rate > 1.8% for 15m window -> auto-rollback to baseline-1.2 and notify #incidents.

eli: ack. tagging @platform to watch router variant splits and fallback latencies. staged agreement: hosted (1% -> 10% if green) -> dedicated (5% dry-run -> 20%) -> private (dry-run only until baseline hold).

cheng: noted. will attach perf traces + kv-cache hit breakdown tomorrow.

ops-bot: note: canary finished 1h smoke, no infra alerts. metrics: router-fallbacks=0, avg-token-cost-saved=21%.

eli: thanks all. followups: rachel pushes goldens, cheng final perf, perf-sheriff to verify alerting thresholds.
